Hi Ana / Raj -

Great to meet you both on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

What we heard:
- Pilot scope: integrate Redwood inference API for real-time risk-scoring in Orion's lending workflow (prod).
- Key concerns: data residency, access controls (SSO), audit logging, and encryption.
- Timeline: target pilot kickoff in August; procurement/contract to run in parallel.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Stakeholder mapping - could you confirm the primary contacts for the following:
   - Economic buyer (finance/ops)
   - Security lead (technical security/infosec)
   - Legal / contracts contact
   - Procurement contact (vendor onboarding)

2) Questionnaire intake - I've attached a short intake questionnaire (20260718-redwood-security-questionnaire.xlsx) and a mutual-action-plan (mutual-action-plan-orion.pdf). If you can fill the questionnaire with the security lead's initial answers, Marissa (cc'd) will triage and highlight any items that need deeper review.

3) Systems in scope - please confirm whether the following are in scope for the review: production API, S3 data lake (reporting exports), Okta SSO, Postgres reporting DB. If there are additional systems (analytics, third-party processors), list them so we can include them in the intake.

4) Kickoff meeting - propose a 30-minute security kickoff with your security lead + Marissa next week. Options: Wed 08/04, 9:00-9:30 PT or Thu 08/05, 11:00-11:30 PT. Let us know what works and we'll send a calendar invite.

We'll also surface a short checklist for procurement (~DocuSign/MSA steps) after the kickoff so procurement has what it needs.

Thanks again - looking forward to working through this.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Thanks Neha / Ana - Marissa here from the security team. I'll drive the intake and kickoff. A few clarifying items for the questionnaire intake to help scope the review: 

1) Data classification - please confirm whether any of the data is considered PHI or regulated financial data beyond PII (e.g., tax IDs, account numbers). If so, flag the specific fields and provide a sample schema (can be redacted).

2) Data flows - simple diagram or bullet list of where data originates, which systems we will call/read, and any third-party processors. For example: lender app -> Redwood API (real-time) -> S3 reporting export -> analytics partner.

3) Retention & deletion - current retention policy for any data forwarded to Redwood, and whether you require offboarding/removal upon contract termination.

4) Hosting/regions & encryption - confirm cloud provider and regions (us-east-1, etc.), and whether you require customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).

5) Access controls & audit logging - list of roles that will have access, and whether audit logs are required at token/request level.

I've attached a short guidance doc that explains how we triage questionnaire answers and what items usually require deeper review (security-questionnaire-intake-guidance.pdf).

Proposal: let's take the Wed 08/04 9:00 PT kickoff (30 minutes). Recommended internal attendees from our side: myself (security) and Rishi (platform infra) - Rishi will help scope any required sandbox/test environments.

Marissa Cole
Senior Security PM | Redwood Inference
